# Trigger conditions

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## activates_ability

A player (`controller`: you (default) | opponent | any) activates an ability that isn't a mana ability. `source`: optional filter on the source's card; `name: "chosen"`: only a source with the name chosen as this permanent entered. `exhaust: true`: only an exhaust ability ("whenever you activate an exhaust ability", CR 702.177).

Rules: CR 602.2, CR 605.1a, CR 603.2, CR 201.4, CR 702.177a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `controller` | you | opponent | any |
| `source` | card filter |
| `name` | "chosen" |
| `exhaust` | true: only exhaust abilities |

```json
{
  "activates_ability": {
    "controller": "opponent"
  }
}
```

## any_of

Triggers when any of the listed trigger conditions is met.

Rules: CR 603.2, CR 603.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(list)` | two or more trigger conditions |

```json
{
  "any_of": [
    {
      "enters": {}
    },
    {
      "attacks": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

## becomes_tapped

The subject becomes tapped (for any reason: a cost, attacking, an effect). A permanent that enters tapped doesn't become tapped.

Rules: CR 603.2e, CR 701.26a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |

```json
{
  "becomes_tapped": {
    "subject": "self"
  }
}
```

## becomes_target

The subject becomes the target of a spell or ability (controlled by `by`: opponent | you | any (default), relative to the source's controller). One trigger per matching object targeted.

Rules: CR 115.1, CR 601.2c, CR 603.2, CR 603.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |
| `by` | opponent | you | any |

```json
{
  "becomes_target": {
    "subject": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    },
    "by": "opponent"
  }
}
```

## becomes_untapped

The subject becomes untapped (in the untap step or by an effect). A permanent that enters untapped doesn't become untapped.

Rules: CR 603.2e, CR 701.26b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default), "attached" or {"each": filter, ...} |

```json
{
  "becomes_untapped": {
    "subject": "attached"
  }
}
```

## cast

A player casts a spell. `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any; `spell`: creature | noncreature | instant_or_sorcery, or any spell filter, e.g. {"spell": {"subtypes": ["saga"]}} or {"one_of": [...]} for "creature or Spacecraft spell"; `name` / `mana_value`: "chosen" (the source's as-it-entered choice); `self: true`: "when you cast this spell" (it functions on the stack). `targets`: only a spell that targets something matching this filter ("self": this permanent), e.g. {"creature": {"controller": "you"}}. `from` / `not_from`: only a spell cast from (not from) that zone: hand | graveyard | exile | library | outside.

Rules: CR 603.2, CR 601.2i, CR 113.6, CR 202.3e, CR 201.4, CR 607.2, CR 115.1, CR 601.2a, CR 601.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `controller` | you | opponent | any |
| `spell` | creature | noncreature | instant_or_sorcery | filter |
| `name` | "chosen" |
| `mana_value` | "chosen" |
| `self` | true |
| `targets` | "self" or a target filter |
| `from` | zone |
| `not_from` | zone |

```json
{
  "cast": {
    "controller": "you",
    "spell": "noncreature"
  }
}
```

## counters_placed

One or more counters (only `counter`, if given) are put on the subject, including the counters it enters the battlefield with. Triggers once per event, however many counters.

Rules: CR 122.6, CR 603.2, CR 603.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |
| `counter` | counter name |
| `first_time_this_turn` | true: only the first time each turn such counters are put on that permanent (an earlier placement counts even if nothing could trigger then) |

```json
{
  "counters_placed": {
    "counter": "+1/+1"
  }
}
```

## deals_damage

The subject deals damage. `combat: true` only counts combat damage; `to`: player | creature | any (default). Triggers once per damage event (each combat damage step is one, so double strike can trigger twice).

Rules: CR 510.2, CR 603.2, CR 603.2c, CR 120.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |
| `combat` | true | false |
| `to` | player | creature | any |

```json
{
  "deals_damage": {
    "combat": true,
    "to": "player"
  }
}
```

## discards

A player (`controller`: you (default) | opponent | any) discards a card (optional `card` filter). `batched: true`: "one or more cards", once per event batch; then "that many" is how many were discarded.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `controller` | you | opponent | any |
| `card` | card filter |
| `batched` | true | false |

```json

  "discards": {
    "controller": "you",
    "batched": true
  }
}
```

## leaves_battlefield

The subject leaves the battlefield (for any zone, or only `to` that zone). Looks back in time: the permanent is matched as it last existed (types, controller, counters).

Rules: CR 603.6c, CR 603.10a, CR 400.7

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": true} |
| `to` | graveyard | exile | hand | library |

```json
{
  "leaves_battlefield": {
    "subject": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true
    }
  }
}
```

## leaves_graveyard

A card leaves a graveyard (whose: `controller` you (default) | opponent | any). Optional `card` filter on its card types. `batched: true` is "one or more cards leave": once per event that moves cards (one effect, cost or action), however many cards.

Rules: CR 603.10a, CR 603.2c, CR 404.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `controller` | you | opponent | any |
| `card` | card type filter, e.g. "creature" |
| `batched` | true | false |

```json
{
  "leaves_graveyard": {
    "controller": "you",
    "batched": true
  }
}
```

## put_into

A card is put into `zone` (graveyard | exile) from anywhere, or only `from` the listed zones. `controller`: the card's owner (you (default) | opponent | any); optional `card` filter on the card. `batched: true`: "one or more cards", once per event batch. With "battlefield" among `from` it looks back in time like leaves_battlefield.

Rules: CR 603.6c, CR 603.2c, CR 400.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `zone` | graveyard | exile |
| `from` | list of battlefield, graveyard, hand, library, stack, exile (default: anywhere) |
| `controller` | you | opponent | any |
| `card` | card filter |
| `batched` | true | false |

```json
{
  "put_into": {
    "zone": "graveyard",
    "card": "creature",
    "batched": true
  }
}
```

## sacrifices

The subject is sacrificed (`controller` of the subject: who sacrificed it). Looks back in time, like leaves_battlefield. `batched: true`: "one or more", once per event batch.

Rules: CR 701.21a, CR 603.10a, CR 603.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, "controller": you, "other": true} |
| `batched` | true | false |

```json
{
  "sacrifices": {
    "subject": {
      "each": "artifact",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## transforms

The subject transforms. For the default subject (this permanent), the ability is on the face that's up afterward, so it means "whenever this transforms into [this face]".

Rules: CR 701.27f, CR 603.2

| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |
